lines.en: The rest of the day dies off without putting up much of a fight.
I spent most of it lounging around with Imani, talking about how school has been for her and how misery has been for me.
Not much has changed on either end.
It’s kind of funny, really — how all of the girls in class like to tell me about how different things are without me but, at least according to her, everyone’s more or less the same.
The loud ones are still loud, the quiet ones are still quiet. The smart ones are still smart and the weird ones are still weird.
I guess that word encompasses most of the class, though.
I miss them sometimes. But it’s diluted by the fact that I can visit them whenever I want outside of school.
It’s a terrible dilution, really — like mixing ammonia into bleach, where it’s hard to realize just how dangerous it really is until it’s already too late.
Something’s up with Wakana and Osako.
I can see it now that it’s been pointed out.
They’re good at hiding it, though. Which is why I’m thankful for Imani since she swooped in and told me before I had to force it out of Wakana.
She might look strong, but it’s all a facade. I realized that the day she broke down in my arms just minutes before I told the girls I’d be leaving them for a little while.
All things considered, I probably could have noticed sooner. And I probably should have listened when everyone told me she actually likes me.
I’m not sure why she is the way she is, but there’s still a lot I don’t know about her. And that’s fine. I don’t need to know everything.
But I can’t stop looking at her tonight — and it’s not because of her bathing suit.
I just don’t want her to be sad.
She’s too good for such feelings, though. And it’s doubtful they’ll ever reach her in the first place when the pedestal I’ve placed her on is so high up that I’d need a rocket just to get there.
They’ll work it out, I think.
They’re adults.
They’re adults and they’re in love. Or at least what we all see as love when I’m sure it’s more complicated than that.
The way each of them struggles to hold eye contact with one another for more than a second is the only hint I need right now.
But again, that’s fine — because my eyes are on her, even if they aren’t meant to be. And she won’t go unnoticed.
For tonight, though, the way I’ll stare is different.
For tonight, I’ll silently acknowledge how important to me she is.
But in the morning, I’ll forget...

Because this is the most miserable I’ve ever seen her — and I don’t want that memory to remain. Nor do I want the image of that fake smile ingrained into my mind because I know it’s all just hope and booze.
And yes, Osako looks sad too...but more defeated than anything.
Wakana, though-
: Hey...has anybody ever told you guys how fuckin’ HOT you are?
I feel like Wakana might get lost at sea the second I stop looking at her.
: All the time...Osako and I were actually voted the most attractive couple in college....Isn’t that right, Osako?
: It’s not. Senior superlatives aren’t really a thing once you get out of high school.
: I ever tell you guys I actually won one of those things?

: Not that I can remember. Which is good, because the people who brag about those things years later are the same ones who peaked in high school and have to live the rest of their lives in a constant decline.
: Girl, why you gotta do me like that?...
: I won a few of those actually. Most likely to win an Olympic medal...Most likely to travel the world...
: And also best smile.
: Best smile? Really?
: Why do you sound so surprised?
: Osako used to get these cute little dimples in her cheeks when she was younger. Now, they only come out once in a blue moon. How sad.
: That one just...didn’t fit in with the other two, I guess.
: The fuck, man? I just won class clown.
: And I won absolutely nothing because I went to a prestigious private school where only the best of the best were enrolled.
: So what you’re saying is that you’re the...worst of the best?
: Uhhhhhhhh fuck you. I’d rather win nothing at all than be voted a clown by a jury of peers. Also, fuck you again.
: Damn, I just got fucked twice in the same line.
: First two times in seven years, bitch. You can thank me later.
: Wakana, how drunk are you? I’ve never seen you speak like this before.
: I’m not drunk, I’m high. Alcohol has no effect on me. But apparently taking it with this new medication does.
: I did tell you not to do that.
: Now we know for next time. And hey, if I wind up in the hospital again, maybe Arakawa will actually come visit me this time, you fucking douche.
: Ay! Don’t go calling my senpai a douche! He’s awesome and great and kind and I’m only sorta mad that he hasn’t boned me yet!
: Arakawa, you had all day and you still haven’t screwed Imani? What were you even doing? Playing cards?
: Oh! We should play cards! We should play a drinking game!
: We should play the King’s Game!
: That game...does not involve cards, Imani.
: And there’s no point in playing it when we already know I’m the fucking queen.
: Don’t care! Let’s play!
: How? We don’t have chopsticks either.
: Beats the fuck outta me. Senpai, let’s go collect seashells and then you can, like...hold them in your hand or something and let us try to pick the big one. I don’t know! I want to play!
: I never should have given you two half of my beers.
: I vehemently disagree.
: Wait a second — half of the first batch or half of the batch we went and picked up afterwards? Because I gave Wakana a couple of mine the first time but then quickly learned my lesson and stopped.
: Yes. Well, you’re a much better learner than I am. And I also didn’t realize it was even possible for her to get like this.
: King’s Game! King’s Game! King’s Game!
: Why do you want to play the King’s Game so badly? Why not play something we actually have the materials for?
: Because even though I’m half-Japanese, I’ve never gotten to play! I was deprived of all the quirky and fun Japanese drinking games and had to play shit like Stump instead! It’s not fair!
: What the hell is Stump?

: Okay. So there’s this stump, right? And everybody gets a nail. And there’s a hammer, right? So you, like, flip the hammer, okay? But the hammer’s gotta hit somebody else’s nail. And if it does, boom. Take a shot.
: But then you’ve also gotta drink if you try to flip the hammer and you miss it, so your hand-eye shit’s gotta be on, you hear me? Oh, and if the nail gets fully hammered in-
: I want to play truth or dare!
: Hey! I ain’t done talkin’ about Stump!
: I dare Akira to kiss Imani!
: I am now done talking about Stump!
: Wakana...you can’t just keep pressuring them like this.
: Fine! Then I dare Osako to kiss me!
: You...do?
: Yeah. Why? You scared?
: We’ve kissed probably ten trillion times. Of course I’m not scared. It’s just a little unlike you to not-
: Drag you into the bathroom first?
: Yeah, exactly.
: Nuh-uh! We’ve kissed at the bar before. They’ve seen us. And we can kiss here because they can’t stop us.
: I like Wakana’s idea now! I also dare Osako to kiss her! And I’m the king, so you have to do it!
: We’re not playing the God damn King’s Game, Imani! But she’s right. We should make out. Like, together.
: It would be hard to do that alone, wouldn’t it?
: I don’t know, but Imani might since the man she likes refuses to touch her.
: As the king, I demand that you take that back!
: And as the man, I am also not opposed to seeing the two of you make out.
: Waiting on you, kitten.
: Is it really okay?...You’re not still mad?
: Mad about what? Whatever did you do, Osako?
: Have you been disloyal? Have you slighted me?
: Never...and I don’t know if you’re just way more drunk than I thought, but...earlier in the shower, you said-
: For tonight, we shall live in the moment — lest the troubles of the daytime grind these weathered bones to dust.
: Uh...is that, like...from something?
: My mouth. You might be familiar with it from “that place your tongue is supposed to be.”
: You’re ridiculous...
: Chu...
: Boooooo! That ain’t a kiss! That’s-
: Ahn~
: Oh, okay. That’s better.
: That’s worse.
: Mmf...mlm...mmnh~
: Mmnch.......Wakana.....I love you.....
: Shut the...fuck up...and keep kissing me!
: Should we maybe, like...leave them alone for a little while to get whatever this is out of their system?
: Imani?
: Uhh...
: Medɔ wo.
: I still don’t know what that means.
: Look it up...jerk...
: And with that, my dare has been completed. Hopefully Arakawa has learned something.
: I’ve learned that both of you are very...passionate kissers but, other than that, not really.
: We used to do other things very passionately as well. But alas, this poor broken body just doesn’t do it for Osako anymore.
: Now, hold on. You know damn well that’s not-
: I’m not sure what I know anymore. Both due to the confusion stemming from words we’ve exchanged privately and the fact that I am fucking tweaking right now.
: So hey, let’s keep daring these two to get it on instead of worrying about me or us. They won’t be able to refuse if we join together in our verbal assault.
: I’d prefer not to? I kind of want to talk more about what you just said.
: All we’ve fucking done is talk lately. You’ll have to do something if your goal here is to sway me. Especially since words are hard. How many beers do we have left?
: Wakana, it’s time to face the facts! Senpai’s never gonna screw me. I’ve got more of a chance of joining you and Osako for a hot lesbian threesome at this rate.
: Hahah! It’s funny you mention that, because earlier-
: Wakana!
There’s a moment of silence, but all I can hope is that it’s not the type that succeeds the death of someone or something.
There are only so many cracks a bowl can handle, you know.
: Let’s go for a walk.
: Yes...
: Let’s do that...
I think I saw tears in her eyes, but I can’t be sure. She was gone too quickly.
That’s how it always works, doesn’t it?
: Hah...

Imani and I remain behind on a beach full of beer cans — a bonfire blazing before us. And as we gaze into it in an attempt to find the right words to break the silence, I wonder if we see the same thing.
We probably do. We normally do.
But she’ll interpret it one way, and I’ll interpret it incorrectly.
As I detach my eyes from the fire, I remember something...and I immediately hate myself for it.
I let my friend get lost at sea.
The current reeled her in.
